title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON THE APPOINTMENT OF SPECIAL PROSECUTORS, ETC.
title_original: 특별검사의 임명 등에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated under the Act on the Appointment of Special Prosecutors, etc. and matters necessary for its enforcement.

Article 2 (Determination of Matters Subject to Investigation by a Special Prosecutor)
Where the Minister of Justice decides to have a special prosecutor conduct an investigation pursuant to Article 2 (1) 2 of the Act on the Appointment of Special Prosecutors, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"), the decision shall be made in writing, specifically identifying and stating the following:
1. Persons subject to investigation;
2. Facts constituting the alleged offenses;
3. Reasons why an investigation by a special prosecutor is necessary.

Article 3 (Notification of Decision on Investigation by a Special Prosecutor)
(1) Where the Minister of Justice decides that a special prosecutor shall conduct an investigation pursuant to Article 2 (1) 2 of the Act, the Minister shall notify the Speaker of the National Assembly thereof without delay.
(2) The notification under paragraph (1) shall be made in writing, specifically identifying and stating the matters set forth in the subparagraphs of Article 2.

Article 4 (Performance of Duties by a Special Prosecutor, etc.)
(1) The case to be specified in a written recommendation for the appointment of a special prosecutor under Article 7 (1) 1 of the Act shall be the case determined to be investigated by the special prosecutor pursuant to Article 2 (1) of the Act.
(2) A person not related to the assigned case under Article 7 (2) of the Act means a person for whom no connection is recognized either with the case assigned under Article 7 (1) 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the "assigned case") or with the cases specified in the subparagraphs of paragraph (3) of this Article.
(3) Cases related to the assigned case under Article 7 (3) of the Act shall be cases having any of the following connections with the assigned case:
1. Offenses jointly committed by two or more persons;
2. Offenses of harboring an offender, destroying evidence, perjury or making a false expert appraisal or interpretation;
3. Offenses having substantially the same underlying facts as the assigned case;
4. Offenses committed as a means of committing the offense in the assigned case.
(4) Where a special prosecutor requests the head of a relevant agency to submit materials or cooperate in an investigation pursuant to Article 7 (3) of the Act, the request shall be made in writing, stating the connection with the assigned case and the reasons necessary for performing the prosecutor's duties.
(5) The head of a relevant agency requested to submit materials under Article 7 (3) of the Act may submit certified copies or extracts.
(6) Where a special prosecutor requests a secondment or similar arrangement pursuant to Article 7 (4) of the Act, the request shall be made in writing, stating the reasons necessary for performing the prosecutor's duties.

Article 5 (Limits on Public Disclosure of Investigation Details, etc.)
The following circumstances shall constitute justifiable grounds under Article 9 (3) of the Act:
1. Where there is an overriding need in the public interest to make a disclosure in order to prevent seriously inaccurate or speculative reports that infringe the honor, privacy or other human rights of persons involved in a case or impede an investigation, or for comparable unavoidable reasons;
2. Where, at the time of instituting a public prosecution, the results of investigations into related cases in which no prosecution is instituted are announced.

Article 6 (Matters to Be Stated in Reports on Case Handling)
When submitting written reports and notifications under Article 12 of the Act, the special prosecutor shall specifically state the substance and grounds of the decision to institute or not institute a public prosecution, or of a final and conclusive judgment, and details of the progress and activities of the investigation and trial.

Article 7 (Matters to Be Stated in Accounting Reports, etc.)
(1) When submitting a written report (including an interim report) under Article 17 of the Act, the special prosecutor shall specifically state details of the progress of the investigation and trial, expenditures, activities and other relevant matters.
(2) Work-related documents, etc., kept under the main clause of Article 17 of the Act shall include the entirety of the investigation and trial records and all other documents, articles, etc. prepared or kept in the performance of duties by the special prosecutor, assistant special prosecutors, special investigators, public officials seconded pursuant to Article 7 (4) of the Act, or persons employed to assist the special prosecutor in the performance of duties.
(3) With respect to seized articles required to be returned following a disposition not to institute a prosecution or a court ruling, the special prosecutor shall complete the disposition of the seized articles or execution of the ruling pursuant to the Criminal Procedure Act and other relevant statutes and regulations before handing over work-related documents, etc., kept under the main clause of Article 17 of the Act to the Prosecutor General.

Article 8 (Processing of Sensitive Information, etc.)
Where unavoidable for performing any of the following duties, the special prosecutor, assistant special prosecutors, special investigators, public officials seconded pursuant to Article 7 (4) of the Act, and persons employed to assist the special prosecutor in the performance of duties may process, in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act, sensitive information under Article 23 of that Act, and resident registration numbers, passport numbers, driver's license numbers, foreigner registration numbers or other personal information under subparagraphs 1 through 4 of Article 19 of the Enforcement Decree of that Act:
1. Investigations, decisions on whether to institute a public prosecution, and maintenance of public prosecutions under Article 7 (1) 1 of the Act;
2. Duties incidental to, and necessary for, the performance of the duties prescribed in subparagraph 1.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 25382, June 17, 2014>

This Decree shall enter into force on June 19, 2014.

metadata.completion_statement: The complete main text, Articles 1 through 8, and the addendum of this Enforcement Decree have been translated into English. Separate annexes and forms are excluded as instructed.
